about.title: About LLMCompare
about.backgroundDesc: Maintained by AI enthusiasts, curating public data on Chinese LLMs — all from public sources. Data is continuously tracked for new model versions and pricing changes (last updated: 2026.05.25).
about.backgroundContribute: Spot an error or want to add a model? Submit an issue on
about.filterDesc: From Artificial Analysis' global index, we filter Chinese vendors' large-scale models, inject OpenRouter weekly usage and Arena leaderboard data, retaining models active within 180 days. International benchmark models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) are pinned at the top for comparison.
about.sourceDesc: Artificial Analysis is an authoritative LLM evaluation org providing standardized benchmarks. Its Intelligence Index combines MMLU, HumanEval, MATH, and other benchmarks to assess reasoning, coding, and math capabilities.
about.priceDetail: Official domestic pricing sourced from model vendor websites. Detail pages show both domestic official pricing and OpenRouter international pricing. The table uses OpenRouter pricing for consistent comparison. Updated weekly.
about.arenaDesc: lmarena.ai (formerly Chatbot Arena) is the world's largest crowdsourced LLM leaderboard, generating ELO scores based on blind human evaluation. We collect its coding and vision leaderboard data as a reference for real-world usage experience.
about.orDesc: The world's largest LLM API routing platform, providing unified API access and weekly token consumption rankings. We collect its public weekly rankings and API pricing — volume reflects real-world usage, pricing reflects market rates.
about.disclaimerDesc: This field guide is for reference only. Model performance varies by use case and may differ from the data presented.

product.dataCompletenessDesc: Weighted completeness score based on 18 core fields including benchmarks, speed, pricing, and Arena rankings
